<!--
Use an English Conventional Commit title, such as:
feat(transfer): support an additional destination
fix(installer): handle paths containing spaces

PR 标题使用英文规范格式：type(scope): summary。
Use feat, fix, perf, refactor, docs, test, chore, style, or ci.
Keep each PR focused on one concern. / 每个 PR 聚焦一个问题。
-->

## Changes / 变更

<!-- Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Include before/after examples when useful.
说明解决的问题和变更后的行为，必要时提供变更前后示例。 -->

## Validation / 验证

<!-- List checks actually run and their results. Explain any checks that were not run.
For Go changes: task lint, task test, task build.
For installer/workflow changes: include the relevant platform checks.
填写实际执行的检查及结果；未执行的检查请说明原因。
涉及跨系统行为时，注明发送端和接收端的操作系统。 -->

## Compatibility / 兼容性

<!-- Describe changes to commands, protocol, saved data, dependencies, or installation.
Use "None / 无" when there is no compatibility impact.
说明命令、协议、数据、依赖或安装方式的兼容性影响；没有影响时填写“无”。 -->

## Related issues / 关联 Issue

<!-- Use "Closes #123" only when this PR fully resolves the issue.
仅在完整解决问题时使用 Closes #123。 -->
